_note: Predictive Sandbox narrative synthesis. Key path: leading_index -> gradient. leading_index is one of the five PREDICTIVE_COMPONENT_REGISTRY dimensions (KVQ, MKI, RWI, DFIS, CATALYST) or 'fallback' when _leading_index() resolves to something outside that registry (a raw index_results key, or its own final default). gradient is 'rising', 'plateau', or 'releasing', matching engine/predictive_engine.py's _detect_windows() classification. This file is consumed only by generate.py's _build_predictive_sandbox_context() for the dev-facing narrative preview section — it is not wired into any consumer-facing product.

rising.title: A Hunch Starts Asking to Be Tested
rising.body: Something you have sensed but not yet confirmed is gathering weight. Small pieces of evidence are starting to line up in one direction, and the pull to act on a hunch before it is fully proven is growing stronger.
rising.action: Write down what you suspect now, before it is confirmed, so you can see clearly what you knew and when.

plateau.title: A Pattern Holds Steady Long Enough to Read
plateau.body: The signal you have been tracking is neither fading nor intensifying right now — it is simply staying visible. This is the part of the cycle where the pattern is easiest to study calmly, without the pressure of a closing window.
plateau.action: Use this steadier stretch to test your read against real outcomes rather than reacting to every new data point.

releasing.title: The Evidence Comes In, One Way or the Other
releasing.body: The hunch that was building is resolving. Whatever you suspected is now either confirmed by events or quietly disproven, and the charge that came with not knowing starts to loosen either way.
releasing.action: Note what actually happened next to what you predicted — this is the record that sharpens the next read.

rising.title: Older Knowledge Becomes Newly Relevant
rising.body: Something learned earlier — a skill, a lesson, a piece of inherited insight — is being pulled back toward the surface. The context around you is starting to ask for exactly the kind of knowledge you already hold.
rising.action: Reopen one piece of past learning or documentation instead of starting from scratch.

plateau.title: A Body of Knowledge Sits in Steady Use
plateau.body: What you know is being applied at a consistent, unspectacular rate. This is a good stretch for consolidating what has been learned rather than adding new material on top of it.
plateau.action: Write down or teach what you currently know while it is stable and easy to articulate.

releasing.title: A Chapter of Learning Closes
releasing.body: The active pull toward this particular knowledge is easing. What was being absorbed or refined has largely settled into something usable, and the intensity of the learning curve is coming down.
releasing.action: Archive what this stretch taught you in a form you can find again later.

rising.title: The Version of Events You Are Working From Gets Tested
rising.body: A gap is opening between how a situation has been described and how it is actually unfolding. Pressure is building to check the story you have been operating on against what is verifiably true.
rising.action: Name one assumption you are treating as fact and check it against a source outside your own narrative.

plateau.title: A Shared Understanding Holds
plateau.body: The current read on a situation — yours and other people's — is staying roughly consistent. This is a workable stretch for building on agreed facts rather than re-litigating them.
plateau.action: Use the current shared understanding to move a decision forward before it shifts again.

releasing.title: The Story Settles Into What Actually Happened
releasing.body: Whatever distortion or uncertainty was in play is resolving toward a clearer, more verifiable account. The gap between narrative and event is closing.
releasing.action: Update your own account of the situation to match what has now been confirmed, even if it is less flattering.

rising.title: A Withheld Reserve of Power Starts to Move
rising.body: Capacity that has been held back — out of caution, exhaustion, or self-protection — is starting to want expression again. The pull is toward reclaiming ground rather than continuing to manage from a defensive position.
rising.action: Identify one place you have been under-using your own authority and take a small, direct action from it.

plateau.title: Power Is Being Used at a Sustainable Rate
plateau.body: Whatever authority or reserve was activated is now being spent evenly rather than in bursts. This is a stable stretch for exercising influence without either over-extending or holding back.
plateau.action: Keep using your current capacity at the same steady rate rather than pushing for a dramatic result.

releasing.title: A Reserve Settles Back Into the Background
releasing.body: The active charge around reclaiming power is easing. What needed to move has largely moved, and the underlying resource returns to a quieter, standby state rather than an urgent one.
releasing.action: Bank the gain from this stretch instead of continuing to push for more from the same reserve.

rising.title: One Action Starts to Ripple Further Than Expected
rising.body: A small move — a conversation, a decision, a piece of work put out into the world — is beginning to carry further than its size would suggest. The window for a single action to have outsized reach is opening.
rising.action: Choose deliberately what you put into motion now, since it is likely to travel.

plateau.title: Reach Holds at a Steady Radius
plateau.body: The influence set in motion earlier is neither expanding nor contracting right now — it has found its current radius. This is a good stretch for maintaining visibility rather than forcing further spread.
plateau.action: Reinforce the connections already in motion instead of starting something new to compete for attention.

releasing.title: The Ripple Reaches Its Edge
releasing.body: The reach of an earlier action is settling. What was going to travel has largely arrived where it was going, and the pull to keep amplifying it is easing.
releasing.action: Assess the actual reach of what you set in motion before deciding whether it is worth a second push.

rising.title: A Pattern Is Building
rising.body: An active signal is gathering strength in this window. The specific dimension driving it sits outside the five named registries, but the shape is still readable: something is intensifying and asking for attention.
rising.action: Track what is building here even without a named category for it yet.

plateau.title: A Pattern Holds Steady
plateau.body: This window's activity is holding at a consistent level rather than rising or fading. It is a stable stretch worth observing without over-interpreting.
plateau.action: Use this steadier period to confirm what you are actually seeing before acting on it.

releasing.title: A Pattern Is Easing
releasing.body: Whatever was active in this window is settling down. The intensity that built earlier is coming down from its peak.
releasing.action: Note the outcome of this window before its details fade from memory.

fallback.title: An Unclassified Window
fallback.body: This window registered on the predictive engine's timeline but did not resolve cleanly to a specific gradient or dimension. Treat it as a placeholder for engine tuning rather than a finished read.
fallback.action: Flag this window for review — it likely indicates a gap in the registry or gradient logic rather than a real absence of signal.
